caption: The video captures a wide beach at dusk, beneath a sky of pink-and-grey altocumulus clouds and a bright orange horizon band. Silhouetted port cranes and a long jetty sit on the right, while low buildings line the left. The foreground is wet sand covered by a thin, mirror-like film of seawater reflecting the vibrant sky. A foam-edged wave tongue pushes leftward into the reflective foreground, then recedes to leave scattered foam patches. The surface settles into a smooth, largely foam-free sheet for a long interval. Later, gentler wave edges re-enter from the right and withdraw, leaving thin foam streaks. The water surface remains reflective, with moving foam lines and minor shimmer, while the distant silhouettes stay fixed.
